correctness.rationale: PASS: From the closed-neighborhood even-scale Čech identity, the only maximal simplices are S_{v,a}=F_v∪{(u,a):u adjacent to v}. In a triangle/4-cycle-free H, two distinct same-color off-fiber vertices at u,w adjacent to v cannot lie in a second S generator: their unique common base neighbor is v. Thus every face containing at least two off-fiber vertices from one S_{v,a} is uniquely associated to that generator. For each pivot p=(v,a), match σ=B∪T (B⊆F_v\{p}, T⊆{(u,a):u∈N(v)}, |T|≥2) with σ∪{p}. Decreasing-cardinality ordering makes σ a free face when removed; count m·2^(m−1) Σ_v(2^{deg(v)}−deg(v)−1). The residual is exactly edge blocks P_uv=(ΔF_u*D_v)∪(D_u*ΔF_v). Each two contractible pieces meet in D_u*D_v=K_{m,m}, so P_uv≈∨^{(m−1)^2} S². Gluing along full fiber simplices models the base graph and yields H∨∨^{e(m−1)^2}S². The projection to H has a one-color section, hence H1 from G surjects; graph Euler rank subtraction gives kernel (m−1)e+n(m−1)(m−2)/2 over ℤ. Our independent exact finite enumerator checked free faces, residuals, and mod-2 Betti for H=K2,P3,P4,C5, m=3,4; this is corroboration, not universal proof.
